CustomField.description: Positional tier computed via gap-detection clustering within each Position__c group, on a confidence-adjusted version of MFL_AAV__c that shrinks a noisy/wide-spread price toward what similarly-ranked players go for (see MFLManagePlayers.confidenceAdjustedAuctionValues()) rather than raw MFL_AAV__c directly. Recomputed by MFLManagePlayers.managePlayers() on every sync. 1 is the best (highest-value) tier.
CustomField.label: Tier (Auction)
